context.note:
One-time notice in the same sheet, shown only to owners who already had Record rides automatically on
         when they updated: an automatic start now waits until Volt is on screen unless they turn on
         hub_recording_auto_background ("Start recording in the background", shown right below as a switch, with
         hub_page_ride_recording "Recording settings" as the link to that page). A locked or dark screen counts
         as the background. Android does not let Volt turn on location from the background, so such a ride
         has no map. Keep "Volt" and "GPS" as is.
